annotations.title: TIA — make visible (enables the trust GATE)

description: Relaunches the HEADLESS instance we started as VISIBLE, reopening the same project, to RENDER the 1st-connection trust dialog on screen (the concrete handoff of GATE G1) — so a human can confirm it. Only works if serve owns the portal (not on an attached instance). Maps to POST /tia/show-ui. Use BEFORE tia_connect when you started headless. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
name: tia_show_ui
